user_story: As a user, I want the system to return an error when I try to get a task with a non-existent ID so that I know the task does not exist.

positive.title: System returns error for non-existent task ID
steps: Send a request to the system with a task ID that does not exist
Check the response from the system
positive.expected_result: The system returns an error message indicating the task does not exist.

negative.title: System handles valid existing task ID
steps: Send a request to the system with a valid existing task ID
Check the response from the system
negative.expected_result: The system returns the details of the requested task.

edge.title: System handles empty task ID request
steps: Send a request to the system with an empty string as the task ID
Check the response from the system
edge.expected_result: The system returns an error message indicating invalid task ID input.
